title: Carry canonical inventory pins and code selections into review
preconditions: Use inventory_item_test review fixture with Storage System r1 declaring store/queue Components and store evidence lines 2-3; commit the Saga as viewOne before revising definitions.

steps.action: Add review Item storage-use with Storage→store path and only store.go line 3 selected.
steps.expected_result: The selection persists the evidence commit, digest and line 3.

steps.action: Revise store to r2 and relabel the review Item.
steps.expected_result: Saved System r1 documentation and its selection remain intact.

steps.action: Try historical store r1 without a view, with mismatching HEAD, with a missing commit, and finally with viewOne.
steps.expected_result: Only the exact saved view is admitted, recorded as a full commit, keeping the committed earlier design available.

steps.action: Compare a committed proposed design and delivered implementation/review across System, Component and data entity, including changed definitions and code selections.
steps.expected_result: The same stable identities and original proposal are traceable alongside changed selections and delivered code.
